rationale: Renderer3D's success rule moves into a public pure function, readback_holds_frame(), and adds one condition: the adapter is not Dawn's Null adapter, which submits commands and draws nothing. On macOS the Null readback was zeros, so success was already false there; on Linux its readback held 169 colours and read as a rendered frame. Real adapters are unaffected: the colour and coverage conditions are unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering pipeline, packaging, golden or Vellum-owned source changes, and no authority moves.
